claim: Arc binds endophilin 2/3 and dynamin 2 and accelerates AMPAR endocytosis
finding: Arc residues 89-100 map to SH3GL1/SH3GL3 interaction, 195-214 to DNM2 (UniProt ECO:0000269 on rat Q63053); Arc KO neurons show reduced endocytosis and raised surface AMPAR
confidence: moderate; binding mapped by truncation co-IP, no structure, oligomeric state of Arc not defined

stance: supports (shared requirement) / qualifies (not an interface overlap)
claim: A 7-residue motif in a 28-aa NT stretch drives capsid formation and is required for Arc-facilitated endocytosis
finding: Antiparallel coiled-coil dimer of residues 99-132 at 0.95 A; this work measures 951 A2 buried per subunit; motif-disrupted Arc forms dimers only and loses endocytic facilitation
context: purified human Arc, HEK/neuron FLIM-FRET, single-molecule photobleaching
confidence: high for the interface geometry; the endocytosis readout is a cellular phenotype, not a direct binding assay

claim: CaMKII phosphorylation of the Arc N-lobe switches off high-order oligomerisation and synaptic weakening
finding: S260 phosphorylated by CaMK2; S260D impairs homo-oligomerisation, T278D does not; Q241/K257/G277/R335 mutations also impair oligomerisation
context: mouse Purkinje and hippocampal neurons, knock-in mice, in vitro kinase assay
confidence: high for the phospho-regulation; the N-lobe oligomerisation surface is defined by mutagenesis, not by a solved oligomer

claim: Arc-family capsid architecture is known at high resolution
finding: dArc1/dArc2 capsids solved at 2.75-3.9 A; this work measures 1601-1836 A2 buried per subunit (12.7-15.0% of subunit surface) in the capsomers; InterPro shows dArc1/dArc2 lack PF19284, PF21395 and PF18162
confidence: high for the fly structures; the fly proteins have no counterpart to mammalian Arc 1-206, so the mammalian endophilin and dynamin determinants cannot be located on them

claim: Mammalian Arc self-assembles into virus-like capsids
finding: Capsids shown by negative-stain and cryo-EM and by RNA encapsulation; no atomic model deposited
context: purified rat Arc, rat neurons, extracellular vesicles
confidence: high for existence of capsids; resolution insufficient for interface mapping

claim: Arc residues 94-98 are a palmitoylation motif required for MEF2-induced synaptic depression
finding: 94CLCRC98 palmitoylated; triple Cys mutant cannot support MEF2-induced depression; Arc binds pure phospholipid vesicles
context: rat neurons, in vitro liposome binding
confidence: high; directly overlaps the residues assigned as the endophilin determinant

claim: Does the self-association interface bury the endophilin determinant?
finding: 951 A2 buried per subunit; Q99 buries 80 A2 (35% of free SASA), E100 buries 0 A2; residues 89-98 are not present in any deposited Arc structure

citation: This work: AlphaFold AF-Q7LC44-F1 v6 + InterPro
claim: Could capsid assembly occlude the dynamin determinant?
finding: 195-214 mean pLDDT 37.0 (20/20 residues <70) inside a 133-205 disordered linker (mean pLDDT 34.1); no Pfam domain covers 155-213; only Q212/I213/F214 are ordered in 6GSE and all are exposed (relative SASA 0.52-0.63)
context: prediction plus rat capsid domain NMR structure
confidence: moderate-high; pLDDT is a prediction, but it agrees with the absence of 155-205 from every crystal structure

claim: Do the CaMKII phosphosites lie in the shared interface?
finding: S260 and T278 are exposed (relative SASA 0.36 and 0.33) on the N-lobe, 17.2 A apart, ~130-180 residues and a disordered linker away from the 99-132 coil; R335 is 34-54 A away on the C-lobe
context: rat Arc capsid domain 206-364, NMR model 1
confidence: high for intra-domain geometry; inter-domain distance in the full-length protein is unknown

stance: Supports a single shared ligand site
claim: One N-lobe cavity binds stargazin and two GKAP repeats
finding: Two Arc-binding sites in the GKAP repeat region confirmed by X-ray; three conserved C-H-pi interactions define short linear motif specificity
context: Human Arc capsid domain, ITC and crystallography
confidence: High for the pocket; all complexes use isolated lobes, not full-length Arc

claim: Is the ligand pocket the same surface used for oligomerisation?
finding: Arc BSA on peptide removal 515-682 A2; 21-residue union pocket, 10-residue invariant core (Q212 I213 F214 E215 F220 Y227 H245 N247 A250 F271); zero overlap with {241,257,260,277,278,335}; nearest oligomerisation residue T278 at 5.8 A CB-CB, S260 at 11.5 A, R335 at 36.4 A
context: Five deposited Arc N-lobe peptide complexes plus 6GSE geometry
confidence: High for the pocket definition (5 of 5 complexes agree, pairwise Jaccard 0.60-0.83); silent on the unsolved capsid interface

stance: Bounds the hypothesis; corrects one earlier claim
claim: Does any structure contain a mammalian Arc oligomer?
finding: Maximum 8 Arc chains in one entry (6TQ0), 78.9 kDa; 196 of 396 residues (49%) have no coordinates anywhere (1-98, 133-198, 365-396); the dynamin determinant is partly resolved (199-214 in 4X3H) and exposed, mean relative SASA 0.51 against 0.32 for the N-lobe body 215-275
context: RCSB search and data APIs plus coordinate parsing, checked 2026-11
confidence: High. 9PZZ and 9Q00 are not served in legacy PDB format (HTTP 404) and were audited from metadata only
